career_ladder.note: Assam Civil Service (Junior Grade) officers start as Assistant Commissioner / Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil) / Circle Officer under Pay Band 4 (PB-4) and progress through state administrative grades (Senior Grade-II, Senior Grade-I, and Selection Grade) before being inducted into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) under the Assam-Meghalaya joint cadre promotion quota (IAS Appointment by Promotion Regulations).

exam_scheme.note: Examination consists of two successive stages in accordance with the Assam Public Services Combined Competitive Examination Rules, 1989 (as amended till 2023): Preliminary Examination (Objective type screening test carrying 400 marks with 30%-35% Assam-related questions in Paper I and 33% qualifying threshold in Paper II), and Main Examination (6 conventional written descriptive papers carrying 1,500 marks plus 180 marks Interview/Personality Test, totaling 1,680 marks for ranking. Optional papers were abolished under the 2022 amendment).

stages.source_label: Assam Public Service Commission Combined Competitive Examination Scheme & Advt. No. 12/2025

papers.negative_marking: 0.50 mark (one-fourth of the 2 marks assigned per question deducted for incorrect answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit score in Paper I determines qualification for Main Examination shortlist (11 to 12 times the number of vacancies); 30%-35% questions compulsorily related to Assam

papers.paper_name: General Studies II (CSAT — Civil Services Aptitude Test)
papers.negative_marking: 0.625 mark (one-fourth of the 2.5 marks assigned per question deducted for incorrect answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 33% (minimum 66 marks out of 200 required to qualify)

stages.stage_name: Main Examination (Conventional Written Descriptive & Interview/Personality Test)
stages.source_label: Assam Public Service Commission Combined Competitive Examination Scheme & Advt. No. 12/2025

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: General Studies I (Indian History, Heritage, Culture, Geography of India & World, Society)
Paper 3: General Studies II (Governance, Constitution, Polity, Social Justice, International Relations)
Paper 4: General Studies III (Technology, Economic Development, Bio-diversity, Environment, Security, Disaster Management)
Paper 5: General Studies IV (Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude)
Paper 6: General Subject Paper on Assam (General Studies V — History, Heritage, Culture, Geography, Polity, Economy, Environment of Assam)
Interview / Personality Test (Board Interview at APSC Headquarters, Khanapara, Guwahati)

financial_package.note: Recruited cadres under APSC CCE are compensated under the Assam Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2017 (Assam ROP Rules 2017). Executive cadre posts such as Assam Civil Service (Jr. Grade) and Assam Police Service (Jr. Grade) are placed in Pay Band 4 (PB-4: ₹30,000 - ₹1,10,000) with Grade Pay of ₹13,300, establishing an entry basic pay of ₹43,300.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Assam Public Service Commission Advt. No. 12/2025 (CCE 2024), Clause 3: Pay Scale Admissible for Each Cadre/Post & Assam Services (ROP) Rules 2017
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated based on Assam PB-4 entry basic pay of ₹43,300 at project standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025) plus House Rent Allowance (10% in Guwahati/urban capital area, 8% or 7% in district headquarters and rural sub-divisions) and medical allowance (₹600–₹1,000/month); net in-hand reflects standard statutory deductions for New Pension Scheme (NPS, 10% on Basic+DA) and Group Insurance Scheme (GIS).
official_perks: Government residential accommodation or designated quarters as per district entitlement
Official vehicle with driver for field inspections and executive duties (ACS/APS officers)
Personal armed security / police escort for SDM and DSP executive field postings
Medical reimbursement under the Assam Medical Attendance Rules / State Employee Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment benefits
Subsidized electricity, mobile, and broadband allowances for administrative officers
